title: Goal Tracking
content: Build goal tracking dashboard. Goals list: cards or rows for each goal. Progress: progress bar or ring. Metrics: current value vs target. Timeline: due date and time remaining. Status: on track, at risk, behind indicators. Milestones: intermediate checkpoints. History: progress over time chart. Actions: buttons to update progress.

variants.simple: Track progress toward goals with visual indicators.
variants.detailed: Build goal tracking dashboard. Goals list: cards or rows for each goal. Progress: progress bar or ring. Metrics: current value vs target. Timeline: due date and time remaining. Status: on track, at risk, behind indicators. Milestones: intermediate checkpoints. History: progress over time chart. Actions: buttons to update progress.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive goal tracking dashboard for OKRs or targets. Goal card: goal title and description, owner (avatar and name), target value and current value, progress indicator (bar or circular), due date and time remaining. Progress visualization: horizontal progress bar with percentage, or circular progress ring, color changes based on status (green on track, yellow at risk, red behind). Status calculation: compare current progress to expected progress (linear interpolation to deadline), determine on track/at risk/behind. Status badges: colored badge with icon (CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, XCircle). Milestones: intermediate checkpoints with dates, show milestone progress (3 of 5 completed), milestone icons on progress bar. Trend chart: line chart showing progress over time, target line for reference, projected completion based on current rate. Goal hierarchy: support OKR structure (Objectives with Key Results), expandable parent goals, roll-up progress from child goals. Filters: by owner, team, status, time period. Add/edit goals: form to create new goals, inline editing for updates. Progress updates: log progress entries with date and notes, update history visible. Notifications: alert when goal at risk, reminder before deadline. Scoring: optional weighted scoring for multiple goals, overall score display. Alignment: show how goals align to company objectives. Retrospective: after deadline, mark as achieved/missed, capture learnings. Export: goal report export, progress summary PDF. Gamification: optional badges for achieving goals.
